# Query the local knowledge base

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `embeddings.query.search.task` |
| Source | `07_tasks/embeddings.query.search.task.yaml` |
| Tags | task |

Embed a query and retrieve the top-k most relevant chunks from the
local vector store, returning a formatted markdown context block.
Wraps lib.embeddings.query.LocalKnowledgeQuery.query.

### Run Operations

#### Python

_No operation description provided._

```python
import json, os
from lib.embeddings.query import LocalKnowledgeQuery

lkq = LocalKnowledgeQuery(model="{{ model }}", k={{ k }})
result = lkq.query("{{ query_text }}", as_markdown={{ as_markdown }})
with open(os.environ["STATE_FILE"], "w") as f:
    json.dump({"result": result}, f)

```
